definitions.gloss: freshly picked; freshly harvested; freshly caught
definitions.explanation: produce or seafood that has just been harvested or caught and is at peak freshness

examples.japanese: {採|と}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧だ。
{採|と}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{刺身|さしみ}→刺身：04023_sashimi⟧にした。
examples.english: I made sashimi from freshly caught fish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{採|と}れ{立|た}て⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直接|ちょくせつ}→直接：03499_chokusetsu⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought freshly picked tomatoes directly from the farmer.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
⟦{採|と}れる→採る：20862_toru⟧ (to be picked/caught) + ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (just done)

KANJI VARIATIONS:
- {採|と}れ{立|た}て - for vegetables, fruits (picked)
- {獲|と}れ⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ - for fish, seafood (caught)
- Often written in hiragana: とれたて

COMMON PATTERNS:
The ~⟦{立|た}て→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ pattern indicates something freshly done:
- ⟦{揚|あ}げ{立|た}て→揚げ立て：08482_agetate⟧ - freshly fried
- ⟦{焼|や}き{立|た}て→焼き立て：08344_yakitate⟧ - freshly baked
- ⟦{茹|ゆ}で{立|た}て→茹で立て：08483_yudetate⟧ - freshly boiled

MARKETING:
Often used in advertising to emphasize quality and freshness of produce:
- {産地直送|さんちちょくそう} - direct from the production area
- {朝採|あさど}り - picked in the morning
